title: Salon advertising: fill your appointment book

facts.fact: Adwave lists Google Search as available in its campaigns from $30 per day.
facts.quote: Search is the closest thing to a ready-to-book client, and it is available from the same $30/day floor as social and streaming TV.

facts.fact: Adwave lists Facebook and Instagram as available in its campaigns from $30 per day.
facts.quote: | Facebook and Instagram | Shows before-and-after photos and short videos to nearby people by age and interest | New clients who choose a stylist by looking at their work | $30/day |

facts.fact: Adwave lists streaming TV as available in its campaigns from $30 per day.
facts.quote: | Streaming TV | Puts a 15- or 30-second spot on the living room screen in your area | Local familiarity, launches, new locations | $30/day |

facts.fact: Adwave lists Reddit ads as available from about $35 per day.
facts.quote: | Reddit | Ads in local and interest communities | Younger, research-minded clients | about $35/day |

facts.fact: Adwave states TikTok starts from $91 per day once enabled in Customize and connected to a TikTok account.
facts.quote: starting from [$91 per day](https://adwave.com/pricing/) once you turn it on in Customize

facts.fact: The Local Gem's guide says a Google Business Profile costs nothing to set up or maintain.
facts.quote: points out that the profile costs nothing to set up or maintain.

facts.fact: The Local Gem's guide says salons that complete and keep active their Google Business Profile usually see better local visibility within 4 to 8 weeks.
facts.quote: usually see better local visibility within 4 to 8 weeks.

facts.fact: A common rule of thumb puts salon advertising spend at 5 to 15% of revenue, traced by Zoca to Grow A Salon, which offers no derivation.
facts.quote: The most common rule of thumb is 5 to 15% of revenue.

facts.fact: Under the 5 to 15% of revenue rule, a salon taking in $15,000 a month would spend $750 to $2,250 a month on advertising.
facts.quote: For a salon taking in $15,000 a month, the rule works out to $750 to $2,250 a month.

facts.fact: Boulevard lists monthly salon marketing ranges of $150 to $750 for a smaller operation and $500 to $1,500 for a larger one, covering social media, email, print and paid ads.
facts.quote: list monthly marketing ranges of $150 to $750 for a smaller operation and $500 to $1,500 for a larger one

facts.fact: A LocaliQ survey of more than 300 small business owners from February 2026 found 52% had a monthly marketing budget under $1,000, as cited by Zoca.
facts.quote: in which 52% had a monthly marketing budget under $1,000.

facts.fact: ClicksGeek's published agency retainer ranges start at $1,000 to $3,000 a month before any ad spend, as cited by Zoca.
facts.quote: which start at $1,000 to $3,000 a month before any ad spend.

facts.fact: The page states that 30 active days at $30 per day comes to $900 in media spend.
facts.quote: At $30 a day, 30 active days of media comes to $900

facts.fact: The page states that 30 days at $75 per day comes to $2,250 in media spend.
facts.quote: At $75 a day, 30 days comes to $2,250

facts.fact: Adwave's minimum daily budget to launch is $30 per day.
facts.quote: Set a daily budget from $30, then add funds to your prepaid wallet.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Reddit ads become available from about $35 per day in budget.
facts.quote: and Reddit from about $35/day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that TikTok ads are opt-in and available from about $91 per day in budget.
facts.quote: TikTok is opt-in from about $91/day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that TV, Google Search, Google YouTube and Demand Gen, Facebook, Instagram and mobile web channels are available from $30 per day.
facts.quote: TV, Google Search, Google (YouTube and Demand Gen), Facebook, Instagram and mobile web are available from $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave states that extra image creation costs $0.38 per image beyond the included campaign creative.
facts.quote: Extra creation is billed separately at $0.38 per image

facts.fact: Adwave states that extra social video creation costs $6 per video.
facts.quote: $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot

facts.fact: Adwave states that extra 15-second TV spot creation costs $6 per spot.
facts.quote: $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot

facts.fact: Adwave states that extra 30-second TV spot creation costs $12 per spot.
facts.quote: $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave states it charges no fee on media spend.
facts.quote: Adwave charges no fee on media spend.

facts.fact: Adwave states that ACH wallet deposits carry no added fee, while card deposits carry a processing fee shown at checkout.
facts.quote: Card deposits carry the processing fee shown at checkout, and ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: Adwave states that new accounts start with an empty prepaid wallet.
facts.quote: New accounts start with an empty wallet.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a campaign pauses if the prepaid wallet cannot cover the day's charge.
facts.quote: A campaign also pauses if your wallet can’t cover the day, so turn on auto-refill if you don’t want ads to stop during a busy stretch.

facts.fact: Adwave states that pausing a campaign stops future daily charges, a charge already made for the day is not prorated, and undelivered spend is never charged.
facts.quote: Pausing stops future daily charges. A charge already made for the day isn’t prorated, and undelivered spend is never charged.

facts.fact: Adwave states that budget changes apply from the next daily charge.
facts.quote: The new amount applies from the next daily charge.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Facebook, Instagram and Reddit ads run on advertising accounts Adwave owns, and it sets up the Google Ads account for the user.
facts.quote: Facebook, Instagram and Reddit ads run on advertising accounts Adwave owns, and Adwave sets up the Google Ads account for you

facts.fact: Adwave advises giving a campaign a few weeks before judging it.
facts.quote: Give a campaign a few weeks before you judge it.
